_comment: Role-based masking defaults. For each role, the value per classification is one of: 'none' (reveal raw value — full access), 'default' (apply the column's suggested strategy), or a concrete strategy (mask | hash | fpe | fake | redact | encrypt). Override on the fly via the REDIBIS_MASKING_ROLES env var, a ./masking_roles.json file, or a settings dict passed to PIIContractWriter. Classification keys: pii_personal, pii_sensitive, pii_indirect, security_sensitive (internal falls back to pii_personal).
